review.rationale: Pairs of inputs that differ only in whether the merge source is an alias or an inline mapping, at 1 to 1000 source entries: the directive before and after a shadowing explicit key, and a sequence of two overlapping sources. Both inputs of a pair have the same expected value; their budgets are measured, not expected.
